findings.observation: The complete mace remains visible, but the upper head spike begins around 4% below the top edge, violating the required 8% safe margin.
Exactly one complete rigid mace is shown with one head and one continuous handle, without a duplicate or separate prop.
The object reads as a mace generally, but the spherical ball with discrete spikes does not read as the required practical flanged-mace head.
The very large solid-looking spherical head and unusually long heavy metal neck and handle are not credibly proportioned or balanced for the required practical one-hand weapon.
Dark starmetal dominates the head, spikes, neck, fittings, and pommel; the brown leather grip remains neutral and subordinate.
Dense dark meteoric metal, irregular pale inclusions, and branching blue-white fissures establish starmetal through surface structure beyond palette alone.
Blue-white energy remains confined to narrow fissures in the starmetal head and upper metal neck, without turning the entire mace into a full-object glow.
The realistic painterly dark-fantasy finish, worn leather and metal, controlled cold highlights with a warm rim, and midnight-charcoal floor and background follow the profile.
No subject, prop, text, UI, logo, watermark, rainbow, gold inflation, or full-object glow appears, but the disproportionately large spherical head violates no-oversized-silhouettes.
